entry_points.text: Ioctl checks write permission then runs internal handler under context lock; compat rewrites size for four pointer commands when compat-sized else delegates, absent without compat.

Task enable/disable walk caller-owned list under task mutex applying locked ops to events and children. Deferred handlers drain pending wakeup/trap work, clearing flags before acting with guarded recursion handling.

Mmap routes zero start to data and nonzero to aux after shared/size/state checks under mapping mutex. VM entries are offset-gated fault and split veto. Descriptor info emits type/config under context and hierarchy locks.

exports.text: Gate for kernel capture from paranoid level, monitor capability and open hook.
Buffer lifecycle: allocate control plus data pages in two variants, init counts lists locks owner, set up auxiliary area, and get versus put references with last-reference free.
Acquire and release the current-task software recursion guard for nesting protection.
Install and clear guest callbacks with default restore, plus misc flags, guest-aware address with kernel exclusion, and ordered sample serialization.

hazards.text: Mutex held across tracing setter can deadlock, so release with migration tolerance is required. Output changes while running can lose data and race close; mapping/revoked/live checks with ordered locking, RCU publish and wakeup after detach prevent use-after-free and missed wakeups.

Aux free in atomic context violates lifecycle since release must follow stopped transactions from close. Parse must free names/text/partial entries and put paths on all errors. Table install maps read-only with partial teardown, fork copy is forbidden, and trap/disable must check tombstone and identity.

Skid after kernel entry can leak kernel regs/addresses, mitigated by mode checks clearing when excluded. Aux/unwind face NMI reentry and scheduler races, needing stateless snapshot, irq exclusion, flags and arch guards. User stack/translation may fault or tear down, handled by shortfall tolerance with skip, fault-disabled lookup and irq-off walks.

invariants.text: Attr copy zeroes dest, handles zero size, bounds size, copies caller length, reports oversize and rejects nonzero reserved; validation masks sample/format/branch, propagates privilege, checks regs, stack arch support alignment defaults, and rejects bad inherit/exec/trap/cgroup/weight combos.

Bounded filter strings route to tracing setter with mutex dropped or to address setter; address install rejects children, parses privately, validates via PMU, atomically replaces and applies to children, clearing counts on failure.

Redirection needs distinct events with equal CPU/target/clock/direction/PMU; null clears; refused with active mappings, revoked lifecycle or lost race. Attach detaches old with RCU and pending batch, waits if needed, inserts new, stops aux producers before publish, drops old ref and wakes.

Mappings forbid split, writable only at offset zero else bus error, need shared aligned nonempty size with readability check and reject revoked. Data reuse needs matching pow2 capacity and live count; aux needs matching advertised offset/size, pow2 length above data and agreeing start/count.

Aux alloc needs device support, bounds tables and watermarks by mode, prefers large chunks and demands one chunk for no-scatter overwrite. Zero watermark becomes half capacity; writable selects non-overwrite else overwrite; empty starts paused. Charging spills per-user allowance to pinned then checks memlock with bypasses.

Open bumps map counts and mapped hook; close runs unmapped hook, frees aux on last aux unmap, detaches on last event unmap, and on last buffer unmap detaches redirectors with restart before unaccount and put. User page sets deprecated bit and geometry; paused and aux presence gate steps.

Samples emit fixed field order with fallbacks and watermark-aware wakeup. Guest applies only when allowed and reported. Regs split user/interrupt with kernel suppression. Stack is bounded with header and alignment. Aux prepare needs active sampler and skips on reentry; snapshot runs irq-off with flag and barriers.

Output copy uses page-bounded fragments wrapping modulo count. Virt-to-phys clears null, resolves kernel only when valid outside dynamic range and user via fault-disabled lookup. Page-size walks levels irq-off with init-mm fallback and low retry. Callchain derives enablement, forbids cross-task user, defers only when supported else empty.

locks.text: Address install needs held context mutex; exchange uses irq-saved spinlock then frees old outside; private parse needs no lock. Tracing setter must drop mutex to avoid deadlock, tolerating migration with held reference.

Redirection holds mapping mutexes in address order; membership uses event lock irq-disabled with RCU; lookup uses RCU fail-on-zero get; aux install/validate uses aux mutex; close combines both mutexes with RCU and restart.
Task enable/disable nest context locks in task mutex; ioctl nests op in context lock; async uses inode lock; fdinfo holds context plus child mutex.

Guest pointer uses ordered assign, lockless read and grace wait after clear. Aux exclusion pairs irq disable with shared flag and barriers to skip NMI reentry. Page walks and deferred bookkeeping run irq-disabled or guarded.

state_machines.text: Address parse moves action/source/end per definition, accepting tokens only in matching state and committing or aborting all at end. Membership pending is set on detach with batch, held across null, cleared by conditional wait before next join.

Last aux unmap stops producers then frees pages/private/array; last data unmap detaches redirectors then unaccounts and drops final ref with deferred free. Aux fill descends orders with fallback/split/tagging, enforces single chunk for no-scatter overwrite, runs driver setup then publishes offset/refs, freeing partial on failure.

Mapping validates, creates/reuses data versus aux by offset, marks uncopyable/unexpandable/undumpable, installs ops, notifies mapped and installs entries with distinct failure cleanup. Data path checks pow2, reuses or allocates, selects mode/threshold, attaches, refreshes, accounts and sets count. Disable branches idle/local/remote; trap suppresses after tombstone or mismatch else delivers.

Deferred request rejects kernel threads, exiting tasks and non-user mode, picks NMI queue mode with arch guard, atomically claims work bit handling queued/executed cases, schedules work and clears on failure. Cookie caches per-task id from per-CPU sequence never issuing invalid, with CPU offset under irq-off.

structs.text: Address state is list plus lock plus file count with action/offset/size/path/node per filter, parents own and children never. Mapping page exposes deprecated bit, size and data geometry. Attr carries size, reserved, sample/branch/reg/stack, format and inherit/exec/trap controls.

Buffer holds user page, data and aux tables with counts, watermarks, overwrite and paused flags, ref/map counts, owner and locked extents, event list with lock, aux mutex with private and free callback. Event holds buffer pointer/node, batch/pending, map count/mutex, wait queue, context/parent, CPU/oncpu, clock/direction, aux cap, PMU/target/lifecycle.

VM ops wire open/close with offset-gated fault and always-refuse split for PFN maps. File ops wire release/read/poll/ioctl/compat/mmap/async/fdinfo. Output handle holds ring/index/cursor/remaining/skip; deferred state holds atomic mask, work item and cpu-counter id.

Facts: attr version-zero min page max, page filter bound and data offset, stack short-max aligned with sysctl default, sample/format/branch maxima with privilege masks, compat rewrite for four commands, shared/writable mode with dontcopy/dontexpand/dontdump, revoked as nodev, control at zero, data zero-or-pow2, aux pow2 above data within signed max, identity and total-times groups.
